_purpose: Golden disposition report for the ShopFlow brownfield demo. Used by ECSA AE reviewers to verify replay-mode reproducibility of Phase 0 — Discovery system disposition analysis.

business_fit.evidence: ShopFlow still maps to core e-commerce flows; SRS objectives remain valid.

technical_health.evidence: ADR-0001 admits Rails monolith with growing god-controllers; no test coverage in repo bundle.

change_velocity.evidence: No CI/CD workflow detected; deployment runbook is manual per ADR-0007.

operational_cost.evidence: Single MySQL primary; scaling requires vertical bumps (ADR-0007).

risk.evidence: 12 high-severity drift findings between OpenAPI and live endpoints; schema drift on 3 tables.

strategic_alignment.evidence: Org target is event-driven microservices; current monolith diverges materially.

component_dispositions.name: checkout
component_dispositions.rationale: Highest-value flow with worst drift and tightest coupling.

component_dispositions.name: catalog
component_dispositions.rationale: Critical read path; split read/write to introduce caching tier.

component_dispositions.name: auth
component_dispositions.rationale: Move to managed identity provider; logic is stable.

component_dispositions.name: search
component_dispositions.rationale: MySQL LIKE-based search; replace with dedicated search service.

component_dispositions.name: admin-portal
component_dispositions.rationale: Internal tool, low traffic; modernize incrementally.

component_dispositions.name: reporting
component_dispositions.rationale: Replaced by external BI tool per stakeholder input.

component_dispositions.name: notifications
component_dispositions.rationale: Stable worker; move to managed queue.

rationale.summary: ShopFlow's business model remains sound but the Rails monolith carries high technical risk, weak change velocity and material drift between contract and implementation. A targeted re-architect — rebuilding checkout and search, replatforming auth, retaining payments — produces the best risk-adjusted outcome compared to a full ground-up rebuild.

key_drivers.label: High business fit, low technical health
key_drivers.note: Spread of 2.0 points indicates the system is worth fixing but not in current shape.

key_drivers.label: 12 high-severity drift findings
key_drivers.note: Contract-vs-implementation gap concentrates in checkout and search.

key_drivers.label: Payments adapter is healthy
key_drivers.note: Recent rewrite means PCI-scoped code can be retained, reducing scope.

roadmap.title: Stabilize: add CI/CD, contract tests, observability
